dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about ores in Sumeru?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: There's no new information about it now, sorry. You can come back another time.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Pattern-welded steel weapons need to be ordered in advance. These are all that I have readily available.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I'm a blacksmith who's been crafting weapons for the Eremites. Sometimes I make tools, accessories, and furniture pieces for other people, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Sumeru worships Dendro, and most of the researchers aren't in the habit of arming themselves and believe in Greater Lord Rukkhadevata. So, most seem to find the idea of metallic weapons off-putting.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I can make wooden weapons, too. But the majority of the orders I get in are for the pattern-welded steel weapons required by the mercenaries.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>I'd like something made.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Your order from last time is ready. Are you here to collect it, or to place a new order?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I'm a blacksmith who's been crafting weapons for the Eremites. Sometimes I make tools, accessories, and furniture pieces for other people, too.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Sumeru worships Dendro, and most of the researchers aren't in the habit of arming themselves, their belief in the Dendro Archon besides. In fact, most seem to find the idea of metallic weapons off-putting.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I can make wooden weapons, too. But the majority of the orders I get in are for the pattern-wielded steel weapons required by the mercenaries.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Victory is yours. I've got to say, you're pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: You're good, but I'm better.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm alright.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Seems like you are pretty confident in your abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: But as they say, people with umbrellas are most easily damped on rainy days. You'd better be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Regular maintenance of handy weapons will help you better deal with crisis.
